mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.0 and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to produce statistically significant negative returns in walk-forward tests (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in real GDP growth below 1% for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth below 1% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered quarters, or the signal fails to produce statistically significant negative returns in walk-forward tests (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate by more than 75 basis points in a single month signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS jumps by > 0.75% in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to produce statistically significant negative returns in walk-forward tests (p > 0.05).
